tools.name: helpspot_get_request
tools.description: Get one HelpSpot request by number: status, category, assigned staff, custom fields and its notes.

tools.name: helpspot_get_requests
tools.description: Get several HelpSpot requests by number in one call (up to 50).

tools.name: helpspot_search_requests
tools.description: Search HelpSpot requests by text, customer, status, category, assigned staff, open state or date. Use the ids from the list tools. Dates are unix timestamps.

tools.name: helpspot_get_filter_requests
tools.description: List the requests in one HelpSpot filter (queue). Use helpspot_list_filters for the filter ids, or inbox / myq.

tools.name: helpspot_list_filters
tools.description: List the filters (queues) the signed-in staff member can use, with their ids and open counts.

tools.name: helpspot_list_categories
tools.description: List the HelpSpot request categories with their ids. Use the ids in create, update and search.

tools.name: helpspot_list_status_types
tools.description: List the HelpSpot request statuses with their ids. Use the ids in update and search.

tools.name: helpspot_list_staff
tools.description: List the active HelpSpot staff members with their ids (xPerson). Use the ids for assignment.

tools.name: helpspot_get_my_preferences
tools.description: Show the signed-in staff member's HelpSpot profile and preferences (id, name, e-mail, signature).

tools.name: helpspot_list_canned_responses
tools.description: List the canned responses (saved reply templates) the signed-in staff member can see.

tools.name: helpspot_create_request
tools.description: Create a HelpSpot request with its first note and a category. A public note (noteType 1) emails the customer, so use a private note unless the customer should read it.

tools.name: helpspot_update_request
tools.description: Change one HelpSpot request: add a note, set the category, assignment, status or open state. A public note (noteType 1) emails the customer. Nothing is deleted.
